reason: This passage (Exodus 19) describes preparatory instructions and warnings for the Israelites before God's descent on Mount Sinai. It contains conditional threats of potential suffering if boundaries are transgressed ('whoever touches the mountain will surely die'), but does not describe the people currently suffering as a consequence of their own actions. The text is preemptive and prescriptive rather than consequential—it warns against future disobedience rather than depicting present suffering resulting from past fault. No actual suffering is narrated in this fragment.
